moments.title: Glastonbury 2027 Tickets On Sale
moments.blurb: Tickets for Glastonbury Festival 2027 go on sale this week, with coach travel options available today and general admission on Sunday.

angles.name: Coach + Ticket Alert
angles.copy: Glastonbury 2027 tickets are on sale! Coach + ticket packages drop today at 6pm. Get ready, it's going to be a scramble. #Glastonbury

angles.name: General Sale Reminder
angles.copy: Don't forget! General admission tickets for Glastonbury 2027 go on sale this Sunday at 9am. Who are you hoping to see on the Pyramid Stage next year?

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Weekend Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Round 2 of the Gallagher Premiership Rugby season is underway, with Bath Rugby hosting Exeter Chiefs tonight and more matches across the weekend.

angles.name: Friday Night Lights
angles.copy: Premiership Rugby is back! Tonight, Bath Rugby take on Exeter Chiefs at 7:45pm. Who's got the edge in this West Country derby?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Local Angle
angles.copy: Huge one for the Exeter Chiefs tonight as they head to Bath for a big Premiership clash! Kick-off is 7:45pm. Come on you Chiefs!

angles.name: Weekend Rugby Preview
angles.copy: The Gallagher Premiership continues all weekend! Bristol Bears, Gloucester Rugby, Newcastle Red Bulls, Leicester Tigers, Saracens and Sale Sharks all in action. Which match are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Cardiff Rugby Home Opener

angles.name: Cardiff Home Game Tonight
angles.copy: It's a big night at Cardiff Arms Park! Cardiff Rugby kick off their home URC campaign against Zebre Parma. Get down there and support the Blue & Blacks!

angles.name: URC Action in Cardiff
angles.copy: Friday night rugby in the capital! Cardiff Rugby are ready for Zebre Parma. Who's predicting a big win for the home side?

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Holds UK #1 Spot
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' remains at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for a third week, marking a historic all-female top six.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Three weeks at Number 1 for Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation'! What a run. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: All-Female Top Six
angles.copy: History made on the Official Singles Chart! For only the second time ever, the entire Top 6 is made up of female artists. Huge shout out to Sienna Spiro, Ella Langley, Stella Lefty, Adéla, Dua Lipa and Olivia Rodrigo!

moments.title: New Music Friday: Johnny Marr & Blossoms
moments.blurb: New albums drop tomorrow from indie legends Johnny Marr with 'The Age Of Everything' and Blossoms with 'Songs From The Wedding Cake'.

angles.name: Indie Album Drop
angles.copy: New Music Friday tomorrow! Get ready for fresh tracks from Johnny Marr with 'The Age Of Everything' and Blossoms' 'Songs From The Wedding Cake'. What's first on your listening list?

angles.name: Marr & Blossoms
angles.copy: Tomorrow sees new albums from two UK favourites: Johnny Marr's 'The Age Of Everything' promises sharp, fast tracks, while Blossoms' 'Songs From The Wedding Cake' is a warm, classic record.

moments.title: Swanage Blues Festival This Weekend

angles.name: Weekend Festival Vibes
angles.copy: If you're in Dorset this weekend, the Swanage Blues Festival is on! Three days of incredible music across multiple venues.
